description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/central_D2_zero_grad_bc driven by problems/heat_1d_zero_grad.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — no per-resolution fixture files exist or are needed. The manufactured solution exp(-alpha pi^2 t) cos(pi x) is exact for the continuous PDE (derivation in the problem file); the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are pure spatial-discretization error, expected to fall as O(dx^2).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
